Can an entrant be added to a nominated entry? Have you just noticed a nominated entry does not include your name although you played an instrumental role in the production? Or, if you submitted the entry, did you just realize you failed to include the name of a person deserving to be on the entry? After nominations are announced, there is a 10- calendar day grace period in which names, under extreme, special circumstances, may be added to a nominated entry.
